verdict.rationale: Svelte's component model plus Context API/Stores (svelte-comm-6) supports building modular, reusable pieces with a form of dependency injection for shared state, but there's no dedicated documentation on DI patterns or architectural guidance for large-scale modular composition. Missing for 10: first-party docs on the Context API/DI patterns, examples of modular architecture, and independent corroboration beyond a single community remark.
